name: scree
description: Local semantic and keyword search over the markdown in a notes folder.
long_description:
scree indexes the markdown files in one folder you pick and lets Claude search them by meaning and by exact words, then read the matching lines. The index is a SQLite file on your machine, one per folder; the markdown stays the source of truth.

Keyword search works without any key. Adding an OpenRouter API key enables semantic search: the notes are then sent to OpenRouter to be embedded when they are indexed, and each query when you search.

Pick a notes folder or a repo, not your home folder: every markdown file in it, apart from those ignored by .gitignore or .screeignore, gets indexed. This bundle does not read ~/.config/scree/env; settings there (such as SCREE_MODEL) do not apply, and a folder indexed with another model is refused.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the folder's markdown by meaning and exact words; returns the best matching chunks with their line ranges.

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: Read a markdown file from the folder, whole or a line range.

tools.name: reindex
tools.description: Re-index one file, or every file that changed since it was last indexed.

notes_dir.title: Notes folder
notes_dir.description: The folder to index and search. Pick a notes folder or a repo, not your home folder.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key (optional)
openrouter_api_key.description: Enables semantic search. Without it, scree indexes and searches by keyword only. Get one at https://openrouter.ai/settings/keys.
